name: SSW 6415
title: Topics in Advanced Social Work Research
description: Advanced content on variable topics in social work research. Offers advanced conceptual understanding of skills used in complex research design, measurement, and or/analysis. Topics may include mixed methods research, advanced translational research, advanced quantitative analysis, advanced qualitative analysis, or other specialized research methods critical to the field of social work.
requirement_description: SSW 6410; open only to doctoral students in Social Work, others with permission.
